data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for remote paywall configuration and analytics
data.what_it_does: Provides a wrapper around the Superwall SDK to present paywalls, track conversions, and collect analytics. It supports server‑side iteration, A/B testing, and ad‑consent reporting.
use_when: You need a paywall that can be updated remotely without app releases
You want built‑in conversion tracking and analytics
You already use Superwall backend for other services
avoid_when: You don't need a paywall or prefer a custom implementation
You want a purely local paywall without remote configuration
data.setup_notes: Add plugin to pubspec, run pod install for iOS, update Android SDK version, configure platform-specific SDKs per Superwall docs
